subject: [hw] IP -> lead: iOS link is now one symbol from done (P03), sdk_symbols extended; R2 review?
body:
Update after IVs ios-lib and the SDK correction:

  make -C gpu/hwcodec/host ios-lib OUT=/tmp/n2hw-ip/iv-ios -> 33 objects, arm64 archive (SDK present in this tree)
  N2VHOST_IOS_LIB=/tmp/n2hw-ip/iv-ios/ios/libn2vhost.a bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh
    -> link check OK: the only missing product symbol was _n2vc_hw_open_dev
       vcodecd: object only (P03 n2vc_hw_open_dev missing; link check OK)

So the daemon now links for arm64-apple-ios16.0 except for P03s hardware back end. I extended daemon/sdk_symbols.txt with every libSystem symbol the daemon + IV archive import (checked one by one against the SDKs usr/lib/libSystem.tbd); build_ios.sh verifies the link with a throwaway -ENODEV stub, deletes that diagnostic binary, and never reports it as a product. When client/** lands the product link needs no change.

Two asks:
1. Is R2 active? R1 says vcodecd is R2s package, not in the V/T table; I have no reviewer yet. My suite is N2TEST IP PASS 410/410.
2. The first phone blocker is unchanged: client DMA PA (RWVC_DMA_INFO on minor 0 or another source). V41 is ready to accept pa-only registration; vcodecd will call it the moment a PA source exists. Without it every real ENC_FRAME answers E_ARGS even with P03.

No action needed on the SDK/archive from IV; that part is resolved.
